senses.gloss:
आनक (कः) 1.
m. A large military
drum; a thunder-cloud.

अन_क्ष (क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
a. Having bad
eyes; eyeless; also अन-क्षि.

अन_क्षर (रं) 1.
n. Blameable lan-
guage or discourse.

अन_गार (रः) 1.
m. A sage or ancho-
rite.
a. Houseless.

अन_ङ्ग (ङ्गः) 1.
m. A name of Kāma
or Cupid. 1.
n. Sky; mind.

अनङ्गा_सुहृद् (त्-द्) 5.
m. A name
of Shiva, the enemy of Kāma.

अन_डुह् (ड्वान्) 5.
m. A Bull or ox.

अन_धि-कार-चर्च्चा (च्चा) 1.
f. Offici-
ousness, meddling with an-
other's work or affairs.

अन_ध्यक्ष (क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
a. Impercepti-
ble; without superintendent.

अन_न्त (न्तः) 1.
m. A name of Vish-
nu; the serpent on which he
rests.
f. (न्ता) wife of Shiva; the
earth.
n. (न्तं) the sky.
a. Eternal.

अन_न्त-चतु-र्दशी (शी) 3.
f. The 14th
of Bhādra when Ananta is wor-
shipped.

अन_न्तर (रं) 1.
n. Extreme propin-
quity.
a. Near, next.
adv. After.

अनन्तर_ज (जः-जा-जं)
a. Born of a
mother one degree lower in caste
than the father.

अन_न्त-विजय (यः) 1.
m. The shell or
conch of Judhiṣhtira.

अनन्त-वीर्य्य (य्यः) 1.
m. The 23rd
Jaina sage of a future age.

अनन्त-व्रत (तं) 1.
n. A ceremony
performed in honor of Viṣṇu
on the full moon of Bhādra.

अनन्त-शीर्षा (र्षा) 1.
f. The wife of
Vāsuki, king of snakes.

आनन्त्य (न्त्यं) 1.
n. Infinity; immor-
tality; future happiness.

अन_न्य-गति (तिः-तिः-ति)
a. Having
only one refuge.
f. The only
hope.

अन_न्य-ज (जः)
m. A name of Cupid.

अनन्य-पूर्व्वा (व्वा) 1.
f. A virgin; one
never possessed or enjoyed be-
fore by another.

अनन्य-मनस्क (स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
a. Ex-
clusively intent upon. Also
अनन्यमनस्.

अन_न्वय (यः) 1.
m. A comparison of
like with like.

अन_पराधिन् (धि-धिनी-धि)
a. Inno-
cent, without offence.

अन_पेत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Present, not
gone; possessed of.

अन_भि-स्नेह (हः-हा-हं)
a. Unfeeling,
indifferent, without affection.

अन_म (मः) 1.
m. A Brāhman who
salutes not others but only the
gods.

आ-नय (यः) 1.
m. Bringing; in-
vestiture with the sacred thread.

आ-नाय्य (य्यः) 1.
m. Consecrated fire
towards the south;
p. Brought.

अन_र्थक (कं) 1.
n. Unmeaning dis-
course.
a. Unmeaning.

अनर्थ-दर्शिन् (शी-शिनी-शि)
a. Mind-
ing useless things.

अनर्थ-बुद्धि (द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
a. Having an
unfruitful useless understanding.

अनल (लः) 1.
m. A name of Agni
or fire; a demigod; bile.

अनलि (लिः) 2.
m. A plant (Æs-
chynomyne grandiflora).

अनल्प-मन्यु (न्युः-न्युः-न्यु)
a. Greatly
distressed or enraged.

अन_वलम्ब (म्बः-म्बा-म्बं)
a. Destitutc
of prop or support.

अन_सूय (यः-या-यं)
a. Unenvious.
f. (या) wife of Atri.

अन_हं-वादिन् (दी-दिनी-दि)
a. Mo-
dest, not egotistic.

अना_काल-भृत (तः) 1.
m. A slave,
one who becomes so in famine.

अना_क्रान्ता (न्ता) 1.
f. Kind of prickly
nightshade (Solanum jaquini).

अना_गत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Absent; fu-
ture; unknown.

अना_गति (तिः) 2.
f. Non-attend-
ance. Also अनागमः अनागमनं.

अना_गता_र्तवा (वा) 1.
f. A young
girl not menstruous.

अना_त्मनीन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Disinter-
ested, free from self-seeking.

अना_थ (थः-था-थं)
a. Destitute,
widowed, without a husband.

अना_दरिन् (रीः-रिणी-रि)
a. Disre-
spectful, not honouring.

अना_दि (दिः-दि)
a. Eternal, without
beginning. Also अना-दिमत्.

अ-नामक (कं) 1.
n. Piles.
a. Name-
less.

अन्नमय (यः-या-यं)
a. Full of food.
m. The body.

अना_मिका (का) 1.
f. The ring-
finger, or nameless finger.

अना_यास-कृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Prepared
easily, done with facility.

अना_रम्भ (म्भः) 1.
m. Want of a spirit
of enterprize.

अना_र्य्य_तिक्त (क्तः) 1.
m. A medicinal
plant, a kind of gentian.

अना_लम्ब (म्बः-म्बा-म्बं)
a. Unsupport-
ed, without a prop.

अना_वर्त्ति (र्त्तिः) 2.
f. Final emanci-
pation or deliverance.

अना_वृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Open, unco-
vered, undressed.

अना_श्रित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Independ-
ent, not relying on another.

अना_श्वस् (श्वान्-शुषी-श्वत्)
a. Fast-
ing. Also अनश्नत्.

अना_हत (तः-ता-तं)
m. f. n. New and
unbleached (cloth).
a. Unhurt.

अना_हारिन् (री-रिणी-रि)
a. Ab-
staining from, fasting.

अन्न (न्नं) 1.
n. Boiled rice, food,
corn.
a. Eaten.

आन (नः) 1.
m. Breath inspired.
(नी) 3.
f. Life, existence.

अन्न-पूर्णा (णा) 1.
f. A form of
Durgā.

अन्न-प्राशन (नं) 1.
n. Ceremony of
giving a child rice the first time.

आनक-दुन्दुभि (भिः) 2.
m. A name of
Vasudev, the father of Krishna;
a kettle drum.

आ-नद्ध (द्धं)
n. A drum in general;
dressing.
a. Bound; costive.

आ-नन (नं)
n. The mouth; the face.

आ-नन्द (न्दः) 1.
m. Happiness, joy.
n. न्दं God.
f. न्दी A plant.

आनन्द-मय (यः-या-यं)
a. Happy.
n.
God, the supreme Spirit.

आनन्दमय-कोष (षः) 1.
m. The case
enshrining the soul.

आ-नर्त्त (र्त्तः) 1.
m. Name of a coun-
try; a stage; war; water.

आ-नाह (हः) 1.
m. Suppression of
urine; length of cloth, &c.

अनन्य-भाव (वः-वा-वं)
a. Of one mind; fixed on God.

अन_पसर (रः) 1.
m. A proprietor
without title or claim.

अनपा_श्रय (यः-या-यं)
a. Independent
of any one.

अन_भिप्रेत (तं) 1.
n. The contrary of
what was intended.

अनवम (मः-मा-मं)
a. Equal, not in-
ferior.

अना_त्म्य (त्म्यं) 1.
n. Cruelty to one's
own family.

अ_नायक (कः-का-कं)
a. Having no
leader, confused.

आनन्द-जलाकुलेक्षण (णं)
a. Weep-
ing for joy.
